title: Fig Shares the Bun
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 1 — Phase 4: CVCC words: two consonant sounds together at the end (no new sounds)

pages.illustration: Fig the green caterpillar sitting on a leaf in a greenhouse, holding a small round bun.

pages.text: Ned sits. Nell sits. Fig sits.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Nell the bee sitting on either side of Fig inside the greenhouse.

pages.text: Ned and Nell wish. Fig has the bun.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Nell the bee both looking hopefully at the bun in Fig's hands.

pages.text: Fig taps the bun. Fig has a bit.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar breaking off a small piece of the bun with his front legs.

pages.text: Ned gets a bit of the bun.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar handing a piece of the bun to Ned the duckling.

pages.text: Nell gets a bit of the bun.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar handing a piece of the bun to Nell the bee.

pages.text: Fig, Ned and Nell munch the bun.
pages.illustration: Fig, Ned and Nell all eating their pieces of bun together inside the greenhouse.

pages.text: Fig, Ned and Nell had fun.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting happily on the leaf, the bun all gone, Ned and Nell beside him.
